prompts.name: tile
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original visual identity for HLDRIVE, a PS5 homebrew cloud-file manager. Inspired by Google Drive geometric folded ribbons and blue green yellow palette, but original emblem: three interlocking beveled ribbons forming a stylized H and downward arrow, small red accent. Dark midnight navy backdrop, restrained luminous edges, clean premium console-library aesthetic. Exact sole text: "HLDRIVE", bold white geometric sans serif, perfectly spelled. No Google wordmark, no PlayStation logos, no extra text or mockup frames. Square 1:1 game library tile. Large central emblem with HLDRIVE prominently underneath. Crisp legible silhouette at small sizes, balanced 12% safe margins, subtle dark radial gradient.
